subject.title: Control UI: working indicator is a Claude-style spark, should be an OpenClaw claw

question: Should the Control UI adopt the linked PR’s animated pincer as the canonical working-state brand mark?
rationale: The existing indicator works functionally; choosing its glyph and motion language is a subjective brand decision, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Adopt the pincer
options.body: Land the linked PR if its small-size legibility, animation timing, and reduced-motion state match the intended OpenClaw brand.

options.title: Revise the design
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open while adjusting the glyph or motion until the visual direction is approved.

options.title: Retain the spark
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if the existing neutral working indicator remains preferred.

recommendation.title: Adopt the pincer
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR if its small-size legibility, animation timing, and reduced-motion state match the intended OpenClaw brand.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current indicator and authored the proposed brand-specific follow-up, giving them the strongest direct context for this choice.
